problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $X$ has the cumulative distribution function $F(x)$ shown in the table below, compute $P(X=4).$

| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $F(x)$ | $\frac{1}{10}$ | $\frac{7}{10}$ | $\frac{9}{10}$ | $1$ |

$P(X=4)=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(4) & =P(X\le 4) \\  & =P(X\in {1,2,3,4}) \\  & =P(X=1)+P(X=2)+P(X=3)+P(X=4) \\  & =P(X\in {1,2,3})+P(X=4) \\  & =P(X\le 3)+P(X=4) \\  & =F(3)+P(X=4).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=4) & =F(4)-F(3) \\  & =1-\frac{9}{10} \\  & =\frac{1}{10}.\end{aligned}
$$
